params.message:
Ask shows what it would keep together with the links, so there is one yes

Asked for the Gentells links of a list, Ask said there were none, asked whether to keep
the pages, and after the yes showed the plan and asked again. It did not write the text
before the second yes. The plan now comes in the same answer as the links, and a text is
written meanwhile with the publishers' addresses. The answer of the tool says so, which
also reaches an assistant connected to gentells.com/mcp.

Ask also looks whether a publisher is known before saying a source is missing.

Portal: Ask bewaart de bronnen van een tekst na één ja en geeft meteen de Gentells-links.
